_what: every counter the arm kept on one dry cell; NO DIGEST CLAIM
_register: DRY, LOGICAL pool (--kv-scale scales test_live2_coord.GPU_KV), flash CPU. No engine and no --num-gpu-blocks-override.

deficit_feed.gain_ruling: D178 (2), corrected by flash addendum 12 item 2
deficit_feed.form: w_d = 1 + gain * (shortfall_d / target_d), floored at 1, PER DEVICE
deficit_feed.currency: on-time CLOUD answers only (D177, D178 (1)); device_on_time recorded, never added to the numerator

describe.source: arms_v5rules2.V5Rules2Arm (covex-v6-rules) plus v5/cf_planner.plan_state for the TOUCH / KEEP decision, offload_policy per-type host retention, touch_policy state pricing, and coordinator belief-apply from engine telemetry

v5_rules2.guard_signal: observed ttft EWMA per deadline class and queued+running deadline work; NEVER offered load
v5_rules2.horizon: causal EWMA of this arm's own observed inter-question intervals per device (D11 / D48)
v5_rules2.candidates: robot sessions with an unwarmed tail at or above the chunk, or a question expected within the horizon

rung.name: covex-v6-state
rung.adds_over_the_rung_below: per-type host retention (max_offload_tokens = 0 for alert and single-shot), TOUCH chosen by plan_state, residency belief corrected from engine telemetry including host hits, state-based pricing
rung.identity_proof: live2/v6_alias_proof.py (decision digest on a dry cell)

covex_v6_state.per_type_host_retention: offload_policy.RULE (alert and single-shot: max_offload_tokens = 0; robot: retained)
covex_v6_state.touch: touch_policy.should_touch with the M6 mixed-tier guard; the CHOICE is plan_state's, the guard is the coordinator's
covex_v6_state.one_price_source: D162 predicted first token, read identically by the planner's TOUCH harm and the coordinator's budget charge (user ruling, 2026-11-21)
covex_v6_state.harm_warm: COMPUTED from the D162 model's per_queue_token coefficient per research/prereg_harm_warm_d172.md; never a declared grid value. Capped at the healthy-regime bound with harm_warm_capped counted

c5_attribution.rule: C5 does not halve its cap for a slow monitor whose wait overlapped a robot prefill the coordinator itself released (uncached >= 200 tokens); on suppression the cap is HELD and the recovery timer is not restarted
c5_attribution.overlap_source: coordinator._self_released_overlap, reported on live2_completed as self_released_prefill_overlap
c5_attribution.uncached_definition: the uncached count the COORDINATOR CHARGED at release (its own prediction), not the engine's later prompt - cached
c5_attribution.status: CANDIDATE, default off, adopted only by a user ruling

covex_v6_fair_feed.gain_ruling: D178 (2), corrected by flash addendum 12 item 2
covex_v6_fair_feed.gain_source: user's flash addendum 9 item B1, 2026-11-22, pre-registered: at gain 2.0 a unit at HALF its target carries weight 2 and so counts double; the weight range is bounded at 1 to 3; a 3x range cannot let one unit monopolise, because D179's floors already guarantee the other types a minimum and only the FLEXIBLE pool and the ORDERING are weighted
covex_v6_fair_feed.value_reader: REMOVED (D177 (2)); no accuracy value is read on this path

ordering.read: hybrid/hybrid_arm.py `_deficit_order_key`, the first key at both deadline-ordering sites; overridden on the INNER HybridArm instance to return the NEGATIVE w_d
ordering.known_gap: the committed call sites pass getattr(<frozen dataclass>, 'device_id', None) and neither EpisodicStream nor RecallQuery has that field, so every call receives None and an unresolved item takes the neutral 0.0; see order_key_unresolved_device

flexible_split.read: share_admission.py:162-168 via the coordinator's SA.allowed(weights_by_type=) call site
flexible_split.rule: per type, the MAXIMUM w_d over that type's devices with pending work; 1.0 for a type with none
flexible_split.weighted: the FLEXIBLE pool only; floors, W_max and the oversize rule are UNCHANGED (D179 intact)

covex_v6_fair_c5attr_rr.adds: release_recheck (D179 (4)) for the ALERT type only
covex_v6_fair_c5attr_rr.share_admission: OFF; the c5attr base carries none
covex_v6_fair_c5attr_rr.floors: PARKED (D188). They exist only inside share admission, so there is no way to have them here without pulling in shares, which would be a second change. Not re-derived.
covex_v6_fair_c5attr_rr.recall_path: DELIBERATELY OUT OF SCOPE. r1 ran all three types and skipped 34 recall questions at s4, taking robot on time to 95 against rung 3's 122.
covex_v6_fair_c5attr_rr.why_the_alert_path: 84.1 percent of the 2,290 sent-and-late alert instants in the committed rung-3 s4 cell are dominant-blocked by OTHER ALERT FRAMES; recall questions dominate 6.9 percent (d190_rung4_margin_diagnosis.json)

prerequisite.why_one_factor: rung 3 on the c5attr base already declares live2_d162_pricing, so enabling the re-check changes exactly one switch and nothing else

covex_v6_fair_c5attr_rr.frame_is_kept: the skip returns before _mon_sent, and EP-G is append-only, so the frame is carried by reference on the next request and that request's n_new rises by it; asserted on the real request body in tests/test_release_recheck.py
